# PRD-RSK-01

**Does every risk, debt item and accepted finding carried into production have an owner entitled to accept it, and a date?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | RSK: Residual risk |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `risks.owner`, `risks.residual`, `decisions.technical_debt` |

## Why it matters

TOGAF has residual risk accepted through governance before it is monitored in Phase G; production is where acceptance stops being hypothetical.

## Rule

Every risk has owner, mitigation and residual; the owner accepts the residual level. A reviewer confirms each owner is entitled to accept it, and that each debt item has an owner and a repayment expectation.

## Sources

- The Open Group, TOGAF Standard 10th Edition, ADM Techniques, chapter 8, Risk Management (`togaf-risk`)
